text: {"rules":[{"id":"HBV-SCREEN-PREGNANCY","version":"July 2019","title":"Hepatitis B virus infection screening in pregnant women at first prenatal visit","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in pregnant women at their first prenatal visit","grade":"A","effective_date":"2019-07","action":"Screen pregnant women for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection at their first prenatal visit","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"sex\": {\"is\": \"F\"}, \"quote\": \"pregnant women\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"pregnant women\", \"note\": \"Pregnancy recorded at any point in the measurement year\"}], \"quote\": \"pregnant women\"}","numerator":"{\"all\": [{\"observation\": {\"concept\": \"hepatitis_b_test\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"], \"pick\": \"any\"}, \"quote\": \"screening for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"Text gives no interval; measurement-year window used as the period in which the pregnancy is observed\"}}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"timing of the HBV test relative to the patient's first prenatal visit of the current pregnancy\"}, \"quote\": \"at their first prenatal visit\"}], \"quote\": \"screening for hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in pregnant women at their first prenatal visit\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Timing requirement 'at their first prenatal visit' cannot be expressed in the grammar (no anchor to a pregnancy's first prenatal encounter); it is encoded as an uncomputable criterion, so the numerator will report 'not computable' until a human or extended engine resolves it.","The measurement-year window for the HBV test is derived, not stated; pregnancies spanning two calendar years may be misattributed. Rule flagged for human review.","The DATE field 'July 2019 *' carries an asterisk referring to a footnote not included in the section text; its content is not represented.","No exclusions (e.g., known chronic HBV infection, prior screening in the same pregnancy) are stated in the text, so none are encoded.","Rescreening at delivery or for women with unknown status presenting in labor is not addressed in the text and is not represented."]}
